subject: plyr: getting ddply to pass an entire dataframe

messages.author: 4b16035cff9b0f8a
messages.subject: plyr: getting ddply to pass an entire dataframe
parts:
I've got a data.frame (dtf) of variables and then a mapping data.frame (map) that needs to be used to transform one of the columns (dtf[,varname], where varname in this case = "hv205") from one value to another, if the value exists in the map. The map is a mapping file for multiple surveys, and I have multiple surveys that need to be converted, so I need to intersect the two of them to make this happen.

A lot of the values in dtf$hv205 have properly been converted to words, but some of them remain in number form.

So I want to replace the values in dtf$hv205 with the corresponding map$value if there's a match between map$code and dtf$hv205. if dtf$hv205 doesn't have a match it should continue to be the value in dtf$hv205.

So, I'm trying to use ddply to split a dataframe into chunks and then pass those entire data frame chunks to a custom function.

fn <- function(x, map1=map, varname1="hv205"){

submap1 <- map1[which(map1$DHScode == x$DHScode[1] & map1$name == varname1 & map1$year == as.integer(x$year[1]) & map1$recode == x$recode[1]),] ##grab only the section of the map that applies to the data.frame chunk we're working with

if (nrow(submap1) != 0){ #if the map has values
tv <- match(x[,varname1],submap1$code)
return(ifelse(is.na(tv), x[,varname1], submap1$value[tv]))
}else{
return(x[,varname1])
}
}

val <- ddply(dtf, .(DHScode, recode, year), transform, test=fn)

Here's the error:

> val <- ddply(dtf, .(DHScode, recode, year), transform, test=fn)
Error: arguments imply differing number of rows: 26858, 0

which I believe implies that the dtf chunks are not being properly passed.


Attached is a small chunk of dtf and the corresponding map).

Thanks for your help!

messages.author: b35e99045f6c74c2
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: plyr: getting ddply to pass an entire dataframe
parts:
Hi Erica,

I'm a bit confused — why do you need to split the data frame into chunks to do this processing? Is the map between map$code and dtf$code only applicable in these subsets?

Also, d$hv205 has class integer and m$code has class factor. Since factors are just integer vectors with attributes, comparing these may not give you the behavior you're looking for. 

You may want to look at the function match(), or even possibly using R's interface to SQLite to conduct these joins. If you have many of these joins to do, SQL is a much better language and will lead to clearer code.

sorry I can't be of more help!
Vince

messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: plyr: getting ddply to pass an entire dataframe
parts:
There are ~800 surveys in the full dtf dataset, divided by country, year, and recode. Each has its own corresponding mapfile, so I need to subset both simultaneously. Once that's done, I am using match to do the replacement I need. This latter part of the code (aka fn() ) works fine, its just passing each survey via ddply that is not working.

I have it working via merge, but it isn't fast enough. I'm using ddply to try to increase speed. The survey .rdata file is something like 6G, so speed is a huge issue.
